summary: Tianci International filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on September 30, 2026 it organized Roshing Future Pte. Ltd. as a wholly-owned Singapore subsidiary beneath Tianci Group Holdings Limited (Seychelles), itself wholly owned by the Nevada-registered, Hong Kong-based Nasdaq Capital Market listed company. No financial terms, consideration, stake transfer, or advisor were disclosed. The entity was formed to leverage Singapore corporate law and financial infrastructure, with intended use for expanding the Company's mineral trading business across Asia. Structurally a routine internal incorporation, not a transaction; watch for subsequent capital contributions or related-party dealings.
